# Town of Brandon municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 3; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists five Brandon Selectboard members: Doug Bailey, Brian Coolidge, Ralph Ethier, Jeff Haylon, and Cecil Reniche-Smith.

Town of Brandon, 'Australian Ballot Official Return of Votes', Town Meeting election (March 3, 2026, certified): Brian Coolidge (625) won the three-year seat and Cecil Reniche-Smith (584) and Jeff Haylon (561) won the two one-year seats filled in 2026.
Town of Brandon, 'Australian Ballot Official Return of Votes', Town Meeting election (March 3, 2026, certified): Sue Gage (757) won the Town Clerk contest (three-year term).

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Susan Gage as Town Clerk of Brandon and as Town Treasurer of Brandon.
Town of Brandon, 'Australian Ballot Official Return of Votes', Town Meeting election (March 3, 2026, certified): Sue Gage (746) won the Town Treasurer contest (three-year term).

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Susan Gage as Town Clerk of Brandon and as Town Treasurer of Brandon.
Town of Brandon, 'Australian Ballot Official Return of Votes', Town Meeting election (March 3, 2026, certified): Bill Moore (212) won the Moderator contest (one-year term) as a write-in candidate.
Town of Brandon, 2026 Town Meeting election warning (Article 1): the offices Brandon elects are Moderator, Selectboard, Town Clerk, Town Treasurer, and Trustees of Public Funds only.

Town of Brandon, 'Australian Ballot Official Return of Votes', Town Meeting election (March 3, 2026, certified): Faith Daya (550) won the three-year seat; Devon Fuller (213) won the two-years-remaining seat and Tracy Wyman (257) the one-year-remaining seat, both as write-in candidates.
Town of Brandon official website, Trustees of Public Funds page: lists Faith Daya (term to 2029), Devon Fuller (term to 2028), and Tracy Wyman (term to 2027).

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists twelve Brandon justices of the peace: Doug Bailey, Del Cook, Sally Cook, Bud Coolidge, Wendy Rowe-Feldman, Laura Peterson, John Peterson, Kathy Clark, Hillary Knapp, Bill Moore, Todd Nielsen, and Patricia Welch. Bud Coolidge is a distinct person from Selectboard member Brian Coolidge.
